title: These Hidden Facilities Keep Your Home Running
description:
Did you know your toilet, shower, laundry and kitchen sinks all go through our wastewater pump stations?

Our Public Utilities crews clean out wet wells and pumps a few times a week to keep systems moving, but it is up to everyone to keep trash out of the toilet. This includes "flushable" wipes, which take too long to break down and should be tossed in trash cans to avoid damage to household plumbing and our sewer system. 

When in doubt, throw it out. Thank you for doing your part! More information: sandiego.gov/public-utilities/customer-support/do-not-flush
